decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The front boundary treatment shall be reinstated except at the point of access to the path and hardstanding, within 3 months of construction of the crossover hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the details of landscaping hereby approved and shown on drawing No. 4/1/2 shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner; and any trees or plants which within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
description: Formation of new off- street parking area for two cars and a new vehicular crossover to house.
